# OBS sub-actions

## Check if stream/recording is running

Checks whether the stream, recording, replay buffer or virtual camera is running and keeps the details for later steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Output** | Which one to check. Pick Other for an output you name yourself. Options: Stream, Record, ReplayBuffer, VirtualCam, Other. Starts as: `Stream`. |
| **Output name** | Only used when Output is Other: the exact name of the output. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsOutputActive%` | True if it is running |
| `%obsOutputTimecode%` | How long it has been running, like 00:12:34 |
| `%obsOutputBytes%` | How much data it has sent or saved |
| `%obsOutputPaused%` | True if paused (recording only) |
| `%obsOutputState%` | All the details as JSON text |

<small>Type id: `obs.getOutputState`</small>

## Create record chapter

Adds a chapter marker to the recording you are making now. Needs OBS 30.2 or newer and the Hybrid MP4 recording format.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Chapter name** | The name of the chapter, like "Boss fight". Leave empty to let OBS name it. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if OBS added the chapter, false if it refused (for example when you are not recording) |

<small>Type id: `obs.createRecordChapter`</small>

## Flip source

Mirrors a source sideways or upside down.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Scene** | The scene the source is in. |
| **Source** | The source name exactly as OBS shows it. |
| **Axis** | Horizontal mirrors left and right, Vertical turns it upside down. Options: Horizontal, Vertical. Starts as: `Horizontal`. |

<small>Type id: `obs.flipSource`</small>

## Get current scene

Finds out which scene OBS is showing and keeps its name for later steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Save the answer in variable** | The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. The default is obsScene. Starts as: `obsScene`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsScene%` | The scene OBS is showing now (or the name you chose above) |
| `%currentScene%` | The same scene name |
| `%obsPreviewScene%` | The preview scene in studio mode (empty if none) |

<small>Type id: `obs.getCurrentScene`</small>

## Get input settings

Reads all the settings of a source and keeps them for later steps. For advanced users.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Input** | The source name exactly as OBS shows it. |
| **Save the answer in variable** | The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. It will hold the settings as text. The default is obsInputSettings. Starts as: `obsInputSettings`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsInputSettings%` | All settings of the source, as JSON text (or the name you chose above) |

<small>Type id: `obs.getInputSettings`</small>

## Get performance stats

Reads how hard OBS is working (CPU, memory, frame rate, dropped frames) and keeps it for later steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsCpuUsage%` | How much computer power OBS uses, in percent |
| `%obsMemoryUsage%` | How much memory OBS uses, in megabytes |
| `%obsActiveFps%` | Frames per second OBS is making |
| `%obsRenderSkippedFrames%` | Frames OBS skipped while drawing |
| `%obsOutputSkippedFrames%` | Frames OBS skipped while sending |
| `%obsStreamOutputCongestion%` | How crowded the stream connection is (0 to 1) |

<small>Type id: `obs.getStats`</small>

## Get scene item properties

Reads where a source sits in a scene (position, size, rotation, crop and more) for later steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Scene** | The scene the source is in. |
| **Source** | The source name exactly as OBS shows it. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%props.visible%` | True if the source is shown |
| `%props.locked%` | True if the source is locked |
| `%props.position.x%` | How far from the left |
| `%props.position.y%` | How far from the top |
| `%props.scale.x%` | Horizontal size multiplier |
| `%props.scale.y%` | Vertical size multiplier |
| `%props.rotation%` | Rotation in degrees |
| `%props.width%` | Width on screen |
| `%props.height%` | Height on screen |
| `%obsItemId%` | OBS's number for this source in the scene |

<small>Type id: `obs.getSceneItemProperties`</small>

## Get status

Checks what OBS is doing right now (streaming, recording and so on) and keeps it for later steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsConnected%` | True if Cuebot is connected to OBS |
| `%obsStreaming%` | True if streaming |
| `%obsRecording%` | True if recording |
| `%obsRecordingPaused%` | True if the recording is paused |
| `%obsReplayBuffer%` | True if the replay buffer is on |
| `%obsVirtualCam%` | True if the virtual camera is on |
| `%obsStudioMode%` | True if studio mode is on |
| `%obsScene%` | The scene that is live |
| `%obsVersion%` | The OBS version |

<small>Type id: `obs.getStatus`</small>

## Play / pause media

Plays, pauses, stops or skips a media source.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Media source** | The media source name exactly as OBS shows it. |
| **Action** | What to do. TogglePlayPause pauses it if it is playing and plays it if not. Restart starts from the beginning; Next and Previous skip in a playlist. Options: Play, Pause, Stop, Restart, Next, Previous, TogglePlayPause. Starts as: `Play`. |

<small>Type id: `obs.mediaControl`</small>

## Recording

Starts, stops or pauses your recording in OBS.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Mode** | Start, Stop or Toggle controls recording. Pause, Resume and TogglePause control a recording that is already running. Options: Start, Stop, Toggle, Pause, Resume, TogglePause. Starts as: `Start`. |

<small>Type id: `obs.recording`</small>

## Rotate source

Turns a source by some degrees. Fun for spinning an image.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Scene** | The scene the source is in. |
| **Source** | The source name exactly as OBS shows it. |
| **Degrees** | How many degrees to turn, like 90 (a quarter turn) or 180 (half turn). Starts as: `90`. |
| **Add to the current rotation** | Tick to turn from where it is now. Untick to set the exact angle instead. Starts as: `true`. |

<small>Type id: `obs.rotateSource`</small>

## Seek media

Jumps to a spot in a video or sound in a media source.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Media source** | The media source name exactly as OBS shows it. |
| **Mode** | Absolute jumps to an exact time from the start. Offset moves forward or back from where it is now. Options: Absolute, Offset. Starts as: `Absolute`. |
| **Milliseconds** | How many milliseconds (1000 = one second). For Offset, use a minus number to go back, like -5000. Starts as: `0`. |

<small>Type id: `obs.mediaSeek`</small>

## Send OBS command (advanced)

Sends OBS one command of your own and keeps the answer. For advanced users who know the OBS WebSocket command list.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Request type** | The OBS command name, like "GetStats". |
| **Request data (JSON)** | Extra details for the command, written as a JSON object. Leave empty if it needs none. |
| **Save the reply in variable** | The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. It will hold OBS's answer as text. The default is obsResult. Starts as: `obsResult`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsResult%` | OBS's answer as JSON text (or the name you chose above) |

<small>Type id: `obs.rawRequest`</small>

## Send preview scene live

In studio mode, sends the preview scene live using the current transition. Does nothing useful if studio mode is off.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |

<small>Type id: `obs.studioTransition`</small>

## Send several OBS commands (advanced)

Sends OBS several commands of your own in one go and keeps the answers. For advanced users.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Requests (JSON array)** | A list of commands written as JSON, like [{"requestType":"GetVersion"}]. |
| **Stop at the first failure** | Tick to stop at the first command that fails. Untick to keep going. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Save the results in variable** | The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. It will hold all the answers as text. The default is obsResult. Starts as: `obsResult`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsResult%` | All of OBS's answers as JSON text (or the name you chose above) |

<small>Type id: `obs.rawBatch`</small>

## Set filter settings (JSON)

Changes the settings of one filter by sending OBS the settings as text. For advanced users who know the setting names.

| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |

| **Filter** | The filter name exactly as OBS shows it. |
| **Settings (JSON object)** | The settings to change, written as a JSON object, like {"brightness":0.2}. |

## Set input volume

Changes the volume of an audio source.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Input** | The audio source name exactly as OBS shows it, like "Mic/Aux". |
| **Mode** | SetDb sets the volume in decibels, SetMultiplier sets it as a multiplier, AdjustDb makes it louder or quieter than now. Options: SetDb, SetMultiplier, AdjustDb. Starts as: `SetDb`. |
| **Value** | The number to use. In decibels, 0 is full volume and -100 is silent (up to 26). As a multiplier, 1 is full volume and 0 is silent (up to 20). Starts as: `0`. |

<small>Type id: `obs.setInputVolume`</small>

## Set replay buffer state

Starts or stops the OBS replay buffer, or saves the last moments as a clip.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Mode** | Start and Stop turn the buffer on or off, Toggle flips it, Save keeps the last few moments as a file. Options: Start, Stop, Toggle, Save. Starts as: `Save`. |
| **Save the answer in variable** | The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. When saving, it will hold the clip's file path. The default is obsReplayPath. Starts as: `obsReplayPath`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsReplayPath%` | The file path of the saved clip (or the name you chose above) |

<small>Type id: `obs.replayBuffer`</small>

## Set source audio track state

Turns one of the six OBS audio tracks on or off for a source. Useful to keep sounds out of your recording or stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Input** | The audio source name exactly as OBS shows it. |
| **Track (1-6)** | The track number, 1 to 6. Starts as: `1`. |
| **State** | Enable puts the source on that track, Disable takes it off, Toggle flips it. Options: Enable, Disable, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

<small>Type id: `obs.setAudioTrack`</small>

## Set source transform

Moves, resizes, turns or crops a source in a scene. Only the boxes you fill in are changed.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Scene** | The scene the source is in. |
| **Source** | The source name exactly as OBS shows it. |
| **Position x** | Distance from the left edge of the screen, in pixels. Leave empty to keep it as it is. |
| **Position y** | Distance from the top edge of the screen, in pixels. Leave empty to keep it as it is. |
| **Scale x** | Horizontal size. 1 is normal, 2 is twice as wide, 0.5 is half. Leave empty to keep it as it is. |
| **Scale y** | Vertical size. 1 is normal, 2 is twice as tall, 0.5 is half. Leave empty to keep it as it is. |
| **Rotation** | How far to turn it, in degrees (0 to 360). Leave empty to keep it as it is. |
| **Crop left** | How many pixels to cut off the left side. Leave empty to keep it as it is. |
| **Crop top** | How many pixels to cut off the top. Leave empty to keep it as it is. |
| **Crop right** | How many pixels to cut off the right side. Leave empty to keep it as it is. |
| **Crop bottom** | How many pixels to cut off the bottom. Leave empty to keep it as it is. |
| **Bounds width** | Width of the box the source is fitted into, in pixels (only if the source uses a bounding box). Leave empty to keep it as it is. |
| **Bounds height** | Height of the box the source is fitted into, in pixels (only if the source uses a bounding box). Leave empty to keep it as it is. |

<small>Type id: `obs.setSourceTransform`</small>

| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Duration (ms)** | The length in milliseconds (1000 = one second). OBS keeps it between 50 and 20000. Starts as: `300`. |

<small>Type id: `obs.setTransitionDuration`</small>

## Show random group source

Shows one randomly picked source in a group and hides the others.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Group** | The name of the group to pick from. |
| **Save the answer in variable** | The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. It will hold the name of the picked source. The default is obsSourceName. Starts as: `obsSourceName`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsSourceName%` | The name of the source that was picked (or the name you chose above) |

<small>Type id: `obs.randomGroupSource`</small>

## Show random scene source

Shows one randomly picked source in a scene and hides the others. Fun for random reactions or images.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Scene** | The scene to pick from. |
| **Save the answer in variable** | The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. It will hold the name of the picked source. The default is obsSourceName. Starts as: `obsSourceName`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsSourceName%` | The name of the source that was picked (or the name you chose above) |

<small>Type id: `obs.randomSceneSource`</small>

## Streaming

Starts or stops your stream in OBS.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Mode** | Start begins streaming, Stop ends it, Toggle does the opposite of what it is doing now. Options: Start, Stop, Toggle. Starts as: `Start`. |

<small>Type id: `obs.streaming`</small>

## Take screenshot

Saves a picture of a source or scene to a file on the OBS computer.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Source or scene** | The source or scene to photograph, exactly as OBS shows it. Leave empty for the scene that is live now. |
| **File** | Where to save it, like "C:\Pictures\shot.png". The ending (png, jpg, bmp or webp) picks the picture type. |
| **Width** | Picture width in pixels, 8 to 4096. Leave empty to keep the normal size. |
| **Height** | Picture height in pixels, 8 to 4096. Leave empty to keep the normal size. |
| **Quality** | Picture quality from 0 to 100. Use -1 to let OBS decide. Starts as: `-1`. |
| **Save the answer in variable** | The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. It will hold the file path. The default is obsScreenshotPath. Starts as: `obsScreenshotPath`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsScreenshotPath%` | The file path of the saved picture (or the name you chose above) |

<small>Type id: `obs.screenshot`</small>

## Trigger hotkey

Presses an OBS hotkey for you, by its internal name.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Hotkey name** | The hotkey's internal OBS name, like "OBSBasic.StartStreaming". Advanced: look it up with the Send OBS command (advanced) step using GetHotkeyList. |

<small>Type id: `obs.triggerHotkey`</small>

## Virtual camera

Turns the OBS virtual camera on or off, so other apps can use your OBS picture as a webcam.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS. |
| **Mode** | Start turns it on, Stop turns it off, Toggle flips it. Options: Start, Stop, Toggle. Starts as: `Start`. |

<small>Type id: `obs.virtualCam`</small>
